name: thomas-local-library
description: Personal local tool library for Claude Code projects

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: [SKILL] Run a structured code review on recent changes, a specific file/directory, or a commit range. Produces severity-rated findings and a verdict. Invoked with /review.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: [SKILL] Detect current code changes with git, analyze what changed, then stage everything.

plugins.name: mapper
plugins.description: [SKILL] Generate a Java mapper/translator method that maps fields from a source model to a target model.

plugins.name: readme
plugins.description: [SKILL] Generate, create, or update README documentation for your project.

plugins.name: backend-developer
plugins.description: [AGENT] Handle backend Java development tasks including creating services, processors, transformers, mappers, routes, configurations, tests, and refactoring across any Java project type.

plugins.name: frontend-developer
plugins.description: [AGENT] Handle frontend development tasks including creating components, views, state management, routing, styling, tests, and refactoring. Framework-agnostic with specialized skills for Vue, React, Svelte, etc.

plugins.name: software-architect
plugins.description: [AGENT] Turn project requirements into functional and technical system designs. Produces architecture documents, data models, API designs, and implementation task breakdowns.

plugins.name: database
plugins.description: [RULE] SQL database design standards covering normalization, key design, index policy, naming conventions, data types, constraints, and schema documentation requirements.

plugins.name: performance
plugins.description: [RULE] Performance standards covering database queries, pagination, caching, lazy loading, timeouts, and connection pooling.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: [RULE] Security standards covering secrets management, input validation, SQL injection prevention, data exposure, and transport security.

plugins.name: excel-reader
plugins.description: [HOOK] Auto-converts Excel files (.xlsx/.xls/.xlsm) to markdown when Claude reads them. Activates automatically after plugin install.
